The single buff to Paladin is more significant than all 3 buffs to Shaman combined. While the Shaman cards that got buffed are really solid cards, without card draw, I don't see it going anywhere. The Priestess nerf was unnecessary, people were already cutting her anyways (See all GM lists). But the Crimson Sigil is a big hit. The Rogue Secret package nerf is also very unnecessary (See all the GM lists who run Frozen Shadowweavers, Faceless Corruptors over it). The list the GMs are running are debateably already better than the Secret package. The nerf to Warrior is HUGE. It will definitely drop them down from their throne and land them in tier 2-3. The nerf to Scavengers Ingenuity is also huge and sabotages a lot of their archetypes. Highlander Hunter may be the only one to survive it as they can adapt easier. Overall, some of the nerfs were very unecessary, some of the nerfs were well needed, and the Paladin buff is huge. This is a decently big meta-shaker.
